desc: Compute coordinate compression of all A_i and all X_i (Fenwick needs counts of tails values ≤ X; compress all A values and use bisect on sorted unique A for X thresholds).

Simulate patience sorting over i=1..N with a tails list; at each step find p = lower_bound(tails, A_i); if p == len(tails), record event (p, None, A_i) and append, else record event (p, tails[p], A_i) and update. Store events per index i.
Sort queries by R; iterate R from 1..N applying that index's event to a Fenwick tree: if old value exists, add -1 at old; add +1 at new value.
For each query (R, X) at its turn, answer = fenwick.query(idx) where idx = number of compressed A values ≤ X (bisect_right on sorted unique values).
Output answers in original query order; verify against both samples mentally (sample 1: 2,1,2; sample 2: 4,1,1,2,1,5,3,4).
Write final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), O((N+Q) log N) overall.
